environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a VPC with default networking. Task IAM role has s3:GetObject and ecs:DescribeTasks permissions. The container runs with default Fargate capabilities. The task is in a private subnet with NAT gateway for outbound access. The ECS task metadata endpoint v4 is available at 169.254.170.2 (not blocked by the application's blocklist which only checks 169.254.169.254). No network ACLs restrict traffic to the link-local range from within the container.
